originality.rationale: Raw joint moments follow from classical multivariate composition generating functions and are not new; the contribution is the proved all-parameter single-positive-interval sign structure and actual two-switch example for two distinct positive frequency counts. Bender and Canfield 2005 discusses part-size marking, not this sign classification; Barbour and Gnedin 2008 studies a different multinomial independent-ball sampling model. Similar previously published vacancy-count results do not cover two positive counts. Implicit coverage of the sign theorem through a more specialized older source remains possible.
residual_risks: Bender–Canfield 2005 general generating function may allow the interval result by an undocumented specialization; only the extra qualitative sign proof is claimed.
Historical bibliographic search is not an exhaustive novelty certificate.
